remarks:
Timeless Elegance in One of Jamestown’s Most Desirable Northside Neighborhoods

Nestled along a picturesque brick-lined street in one of Jamestown’s most sought-after Northside neighborhoods, this distinguished 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers an exceptional blend of classic architectural charm, thoughtful modern updates, and gracious living spaces.

From the moment you enter, you’ll appreciate the warmth and character of beautiful hardwood floors, charming built-ins, and timeless details throughout. The spacious kitchen features an inviting breakfast nook, while the elegant formal dining room provides a wonderful setting for entertaining and memorable gatherings. A versatile main-level office offers the flexibility of a potential fifth bedroom, complemented by a conveniently located first-floor half bath.

The second level features four spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a bedroom with its own private balcony—a delightful place to enjoy a quiet moment.

Step outside to your own private retreat, where a fully fenced backyard offers space for relaxation and entertaining. The deck, conveniently accessed from the home, features an awning that provides welcome shade on warm summer afternoons. An attached two-car garage adds both comfort and convenience.

Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully enhanced, this home boasts an impressive collection of recent improvements, including the installation of central air conditioning, a brand-new garage door, new fencing, newly installed and refinished hardwood flooring, and tastefully updated bathrooms.

Rich in character, enhanced by modern comforts, and situated in a truly desirable setting, this exceptional Northside home presents a wonderful opportunity to enjoy one of Jamestown’s most cherished neighborhoods.

An extensive list of recent improvements and upgrades is available in the  attachments.
